do_not: re-add a paper already in derived_from
refresh a README or retune a classifier when idle (run-80 rule)
give an old capability/model-benchmark result the same weight as a current one (recency weighting, user directive 2026-09-06)
rules: IDLE-STATE RULE (run 80): if the last 3 runs were all doc-refresh / hygiene / 'other', AND an arXiv sweep returned nothing past the known frontier, AND tools/selftest_all.py is GREEN, then the run's increment must be one of: (a) deepen ONE existing node with a targeted citation sweep (S2 citations on its source), (b) dry-run one probe design from docs/emergence_probe_catalogue.md end to end, or (c) a genuine consistency/adversarial pass. Do NOT refresh a README or retune a classifier again.

RECENCY WEIGHTING (user directive, 2026-09-06 - a weighting, NOT a gate): PREFER the last ~30 days (sort arXiv/S2 by submittedDate descending; today is 2026-09-06). Older papers are NOT locked out. When folding one: (i) note in the node which model / harness generation it was measured on; (ii) keep confidence modest and add 'possibly superseded' if it is a capability / model-benchmark claim, since it describes OLD models and harnesses; (iii) an old result is still valid evidence about the SMALL / LOCAL LLM regime - say so. Latest information gets more weight in any tension.
